report.summary: Analyzed chunk 10 of embeddings.py: contains _check_journal_status, _store_batch, and ingest_events_report. Claims about freshness/fork detection, batch insertion, and ingest report entry are checked.
risks: _store_batch | medium | INSERT OR IGNORE may silently skip duplicate source_hash; caller may expect all events stored. | Add a return or log for skipped duplicates.
ingest_events_report | high | process() closure captures resolved from outer scope but does not update it; spec resolution may be incomplete. | Ensure resolved is updated after spec resolution.
ingest_events_report | medium | EmbeddingUnavailableError caught but status returned; no further error propagation shown. | Verify that callers handle this status correctly.

handoff.purpose: Contains journal status checking, batch insertion of projections, and public ingest_events_report method.

symbols.name: _check_journal_status
symbols.note: Private method that compares recorded vs observed journal state and returns status (fresh, journal_forked, journal_ahead, or journal_behind).

symbols.name: _store_batch
symbols.note: Inserts events and their embeddings into projection_sources and event_projections tables using INSERT OR IGNORE.

symbols.name: ingest_events_report
symbols.note: Public method that projects events via backend embedding and returns an IngestReport. Contains a nested function process() that handles batching.

observations.what: _check_journal_status returns status objects with available flag based on comparison of recorded and observed positions and content hashes.
_store_batch uses INSERT OR IGNORE; duplicates based on source_hash or projection_id are silently ignored.
ingest_events_report has a nested function process that captures nonlocal projected and resolved, but resolved is not updated inside process; spec resolution from parameter only happens at top.
EmbeddingUnavailableError is caught and a status is returned; no re-raise or alternative handling.
